core_obligations: Localization: the question is local on Y so assume Y affine; by the induction principle together with the relative Mayer-Vietoris lemma reduce to X affine (proof lines 4939-4941).

Affine case: choose a finitely presented closed immersion i : X -> A^n_Y; Rf_! = Rp_! after Ri_! by the composition lemma and Ri_! = i_! preserves constructibility, so reduce to the projection A^n_Y -> Y and then along the tower of projections to n = 1 (proof lines 4943-4958).

The A^1 case: Rf_! has finite cohomological dimension so K may be assumed bounded below; the first spectral sequence of the two-spectral-sequence lemma reduces to the relative dimension 1 case (proof lines 4960-4968).
proof_roadmap: Localization on Y and reduction to affine X (proof lines 4939-4941).
Closed immersion factorization and descent along the A^1 tower (proof lines 4943-4958).
Spectral sequence reduction to the relative dimension 1 case (proof lines 4960-4968).
